style: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production game inventory icon, inspired by Slay the Spire 2 item art. Transparent RGBA background, absolutely no opaque background or checkerboard. Square canvas, one isolated object centered, fully visible, filling about 82% of canvas with generous clear edges. Hand-painted 2D fantasy cartoon, bold near-black irregular contour, large simple color blocks, two or three shaded tones, subtle dry-brush texture, clear readable silhouette at 64px. NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D render, no ornate microdetail, no text, lettering, numbers, labels, UI border, cast shadow, scenery or particles outside object. Architect theme: muted antique brass, parchment ivory, desaturated blue, restrained cyan magical accent. Final source will be downscaled to game-native 256px PNG.
